concerns.text: FR-003 and US-2 mandate a strict two-group design (pattern-guided vs. baseline) for 50 pairs. Tasks T021/T022 implement these two groups, but the Plan Summary and T024 description reference a 'random-pattern' arm or 'three-arm design' which is not in the spec. While T021/T022 cover the required FR, the presence of 'random-pattern' in task descriptions (T024) and plan text creates ambiguity. A specific task to explicitly exclude or ignore the 'random-pattern' arm mentioned in the plan summary is missing to ensure the implementation strictly adheres to the two-group spec requirement.

FR-004 requires experts to be 'verified via ORCID' AND have '≥5 years of domain experience'. Tasks T030/T030b only implement ORCID format validation (regex) and loading of ratings. There is no task to verify the '≥5 years experience' constraint or the actual 'verified via ORCID' status (beyond format). The implementer cannot satisfy the full FR-004 requirement without a task to validate the experience years or the verification status.

Spec Edge Cases require a sensitivity analysis that 're-runs the statistical test with outliers removed'. Task T035a implements the outlier removal logic (IQR) and T035b flags power issues, but neither task explicitly includes the step to 're-run' the statistical test (T033/T034) with the cleaned dataset to verify robustness. The implementation of the sensitivity analysis is incomplete without the re-execution step.

FR-006 requires the final report to explicitly include the phrase 'associational, not causal'. Task T037 generates the report and mentions including the phrase, but lacks a specific verification task (e.g., an assertion or parser check) to confirm the phrase is present in the generated output. Without this verification, the rhetorical constraint is not testable.

Task T024 description mentions 'strict two-group pairing' but the Plan Summary and T024 text also reference 'random-pattern' or 'three-arm design'. This creates a stale tag/contradiction in the task description itself. The task should be clarified to remove any reference to a 'random-pattern' arm to align strictly with the spec's two-group design.
